component.name: Badge
component.description: Compact label displaying status, category, or metadata with optional remove functionality.

parts.label: status icon
parts.description: Optional semantic icon indicating state (success, error, warning, info).

parts.label: badge text
parts.description: Main badge content (text or React nodes).

parts.label: remove button
parts.description: Optional close/remove button for dismissible badges.

constraints: Badge text does not wrap (white-space: nowrap).
Square variant has equal width and height.

default.primary: state-specific solid color (success green, error red, etc.)

backgrounds.hover: no hover state (not interactive except remove button)

text.primary: var(--color-white) for colored states, var(--color-black) for neutral

visualStyle.iconMotion: No transitions. Remove button has hover/active states.

behavior.map: Badge displays static status or category label. If removable=true, clicking remove button calls onRemove callback and animates badge removal. Semantic icons auto-inject based on state prop.
behavior.stateModel: controlled (visibility via parent state after onRemove)
behavior.rendering: Badge always renders unless visibility controlled by parent. Remove button renders conditionally when removable=true.
behavior.defaultState: Visible with neutral state (no icon) unless state prop specifies semantic state.

logic.effect: Calls onRemove callback. Parent controls visibility state.

feedback.hover: Remove button shows hover state (background darken). Badge itself not interactive.
feedback.active: Remove button shows active state (background darker).

states.default: Badge displayed with neutral or specified state styling.
states.success: Green background (primary) or border (secondary) with checkmark icon.
states.error: Red background/border with X circle icon.
states.warning: Yellow/orange background/border with warning triangle icon.
states.info: Blue background/border with info circle icon.
states.removable: Remove button (X) appears on trailing edge.

layout: Text content must not wrap (truncate with ellipsis if needed).
content: Children should be concise (5-15 characters recommended).
Icon is auto-injected for semantic states unless custom icon provided.
Remove button has i18n accessible label.
nesting: Badge children should be text or simple inline elements.
Complex components (buttons, inputs) should not be nested.

aria.label: Remove button has aria-label from i18n: t('badge.remove', { label }).
aria.live: If badge removal affects page content, parent should use aria-live region.

accessibility.keyboard: Remove button is keyboard accessible (Tab, Enter/Space to activate).
accessibility.focus: Remove button has visible focus indicator.

contrast.primary: White text on colored background meets WCAG AA.
contrast.secondary: Colored text on white background meets WCAG AA.

responsiveness.rules: Badge size is intrinsic. Text does not wrap. On small screens, parent layout should handle wrapping or scrolling multiple badges.

usageNotes: Use primary design for prominent status indicators.
Use secondary design for subtle categorization.
State prop auto-injects semantic icon (success, error, warning, info).
For custom icons, pass icon prop (overrides semantic icon).
Remove button requires onRemove callback; parent manages visibility.
Keep badge text concise (5-15 characters ideal).
Square variant useful for icon-only badges or counts.
